authority_note: Compatibility is determined from live technical support, never from assumption. DEC-032 §9 forbids fabricating combinations such as Stitch+Opus unless the route genuinely exists. A pair absent from this registry is BLOCKED, not merely unranked.

claude-code.evidence: Anthropic subscription models run through the official Claude Code CLI. Candidate pairs are technically supported but carry no DIAL execution evidence until qualified.

codex-app-server.evidence: Codex App Server hosts ChatGPT-subscription models. Additional models enter via discovery, not by being written here.

antigravity.evidence: Provider-native models returned by authenticated live `agy models` discovery are candidates automatically when they retain the google-subscription route and provider_native family. Static `antigravity-native` remains only as a legacy compatibility shim.

composition_instead_of_fabrication.note: §10/§33. When a reasoning model cannot run inside a harness, the answer is composition, not a fictional pair.

examples.use_case: browser/visual execution driven by external architecture reasoning
